admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade.

applicability: Every place that decides whether an agent is in a turn.
conditions: Activity intake itself stays event-driven and qualified per boot after registry recovery and a matching snapshot.

The three-second held-delivery tick shares one stat-keyed parse of the complete publication. Idle, closed or ended observations can trigger the recipient check, and the same ending IDs reach the explainer turn-end callback when wired. Usage uses separate stamps and a bound port, and runs only on a new stamped idle observation of a registered role agent.
A recovery attempt that cannot qualify the registry returns before snapshot invocation. Another independent publication or startup can retry it.
exclusions: No idle status polling and no second status store exist for activity.
The tick's read is not an activity intake and publishes no status of its own.

statement: Bound role-agent activity is published from host transitions and qualified per boot after registry recovery and a matching snapshot. Task activity is event driven. The held-delivery tick shares a parsed publication for recipient ending observations and a separate stamped idle usage selection. A separate send-time turn check can hold a message for a recipient in a turn.
